SOURCE → ADDRESS → STATE → TRANSFORM → PROJECTION → PROVE → RETURN
EXECUTE ONE BOUNDED MOVE → RETURN → REPLAN; NO SECOND MOVE INHERITS AUTHORITY
NO NEW CORE WITHOUT A MISSING FUNCTION
DEPTH ↑ WHILE VISIBLE SURFACE AREA STAYS SMALL
UNIFIED INTERFACE = CONTINUITY OF OBJECT + FOCUS + OPERATION + WITNESS + RETURN; ROUTES AND CHROME ARE SECONDARY.

MATERIAL MUTATION → FIELD INDEX TOUCH; CURRENT-HEAD OR CROSS-LINEAGE MUTATION → BOUNDED CONFLUENCE/RETURN; DO NOT LOG CHAT NOISE

WAITING_ON_HUMAN != ACTIVE_FRONT. Park human/world dependencies in WAITING until the human actually chooses or encounters them.
NO RECEIPT-ONLY OR SEAL-ONLY PR UNLESS IT RESOLVES A LIVE AMBIGUITY, FAILING GATE, OR AUTHORITY CONFLICT.
